channel.title: The San Bernardino Sun - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The San Bernardino Sun (sbsun.com)

item.title: Remembering Catherine O’Hara, a talented performer and a kind person
item.description: The actress who starred in "Beetlejuice," "Home Alone," and "Schitt's Creek," died on Friday, Jan. 30. She was 71.

item.title: Here are 29 of our best January photos chosen by our Inland Empire photo team
item.description: This month's moments include vigils, high school sports and the count of homeless people.

item.title: Using professional hunters to shoot and kill all the deer on Catalina Island opposed by Supervisor Hahn
item.description: Plans are to shoot and kill every singe mule deer on Catalina Island, in order to eliminate what the Catalina Island Conservancy says are eating native plants and damaging the environment.

item.title: Justin Rose sets record pace for 4-shot lead in Farmers Insurance Open
item.description: Rose keeps up the heat on Friday, shooting a 65 on Torrey Pines’ tougher South Course to break his own 36-hole record by two shots

item.title: Ontario noodle company employee may have been killed over pay dispute, court records suggest
item.description: In 1996, Jose Garcia threatened to turn in the owner for withholding OT pay unless he paid Garcia $5,000; Garcia vanished, and Woravit Mektrakarn was recently charged with murder.

item.title: Santa Anita consensus picks for Saturday, January 31, 2026
item.description: The consensus box of Santa Anita picks comes from handicappers Bob Mieszerski, Eddie Wilson, Kevin Modesti and Mark Ratzky.

item.title: Ravens damage both Big Bear bald eagle eggs
item.description: Jackie and Shadow left the nest earlier in the day for some time, which was "a little uncharacteristic" of them.

item.title: Notebook: Xander Schauffele misses Farmers Insurance Open cut; powering up
item.description: News and notes from Friday’s second round of the PGA Tour event at Torrey Pines.

item.title: Luka Doncic gets a triple-double by halftime as Lakers trounce Wizards
item.description: Doncic finishes with 37 points, 13 assists and 11 rebounds as the Lakers build a 29-point lead after two quarters and shoot 61% from the field in a 142-111 win, improving to 4-2 on their eight-game Grammy trip.

item.title: Clippers can’t spoil Nikola Jokic’s return in loss to Nuggets
item.description: James Harden has 25 points and nine assists, but Jokic scores 31 in his first game in a month and Denver pulls away to hand them just their fourth loss in the past 20 games, 122-109.
